status: simplified direct-flange ear-root iteration for F-10/F-11/F-12; preserve the accepted V3 fit body and three mounting locations per side; replace V4's loose blue clamps with orange insert-owned tabs and direct M3 screws into green shell bosses; accept that permanent tabs block the old fully assembled 60 mm service path and require upper-head release for insert service; no STL, G-code, print release, ear change, upper-head source change, eye change, rear-cassette change, reinforcement change, C006 change, or aluminum change

retention.fastener: M3 button-head screw and 7 mm washer into an M3 heat-set insert captured in the shell anchor; installed and removed from inside only
retention.seated_datum_strategy: the accepted V3 shallow cap and exterior planes define broad seating; no added fixed ledge enters the moving envelope
retention.manual_hole_adjustment: The orange direct-flange clearance hole may be drilled larger during physical fit-up if small positional adjustment is required; retain the 7 mm washer and verify edge distance before final assembly.

assembly_sequence: For initial assembly, position the accepted yellow fit body and its permanent orange direct flanges before the upper-head shells are finally secured.

Seat the accepted V3 shallow cap and exterior planes flush by hand, align the three orange clearance holes over the green shell-boss threads, and install the washers and M3 screws directly from inside.
If physical fit-up needs minor adjustment, enlarge only the orange clearance hole, retain the 7 mm washer, and preserve safe material around the hole.
For later insert removal, first remove the ear, screws, and washers, then loosen or remove the applicable upper-head shell; do not force the permanent orange flanges through the old V3 path.
review_holds: V5 addresses only F-10/F-11/F-12 and replaces rejected V4 clamp complexity. F-13/F-14 outer-ear anti-flap work remains a later independent bucket.
The accepted V3 yellow fit bodies, 13/9 mm visible saddle relief, 2.5/1.0 mm fit clearances, and 0.4 mm exact-ear clearance remain unchanged.

The accepted V3 deep body remains clear on its old 60 mm path, but the new permanent orange flanges do not: upper-head shell release is required for insert service. This is the explicit simplicity/serviceability tradeoff of V5.
There are no blue clamps or loose connector pieces: each orange tab belongs to the insert and each M3 screw passes directly through its standard clearance hole into the matching green shell boss.
Green anchor geometry is review-only proposed shell integration. Exact Gate 8 source ears and upper heads remain unchanged in this blend.
M3 heat-set hardware and any manually enlarged orange hole require physical coupons; green-boss source-shell integration remains unresolved and blocked from print release.
Accepted eye mounts, lower-face/rear-cassette ownership, reinforcement direction, C006, and aluminum V0.5 remain unchanged.
No STL, G-code, slicer project, fabrication output, or print release is produced.
